renderedFields.description:
The bug

When the player is holding a loaded crossbow in their offhand and not holding anything in their main hand, the main hand will not display correctly.

How to reproduce

  1. Take a crossbow in your secondary hand
  2. Charge your crossbow
  3. Watch how your main hand is displayed

Example

Here is an example:
